# 📖 English — Magic-e and Vowel Team Words

Welcome to Term 2, Grade 2! Today we learn two new **word patterns**. 🎉

## ✨ CVCe Words (The "Magic e")
When a short word ends in a silent **e**, the **e** is magic — it makes the vowel before it say its own **name**!

- **cake** — the **a** says its name "ay"
- **bike** — the **i** says its name "eye"
- **home** — the **o** says its name "oh"
- **cute** — the **u** says its name "you"

**Example 1:** *cap* (short a) becomes **cape** (long a) when we add the magic e!

**Example 2:** *kit* (short i) becomes **kite** (long i) when we add the magic e!

## 🌈 CVVC Words (Vowel Teams)
Some words have **two vowels together**. Usually, the **first vowel says its name** and the second vowel is quiet.

- **rain** — the **a** talks, the **i** is quiet
- **boat** — the **o** talks, the **a** is quiet
- **feet** — the **e** says its name
- **tail** — the **a** says its name

**Example:** *"The rain fell on the boat."* Both **rain** and **boat** have vowel teams!

## 📝 Reading Practice
Try reading these out loud: **cake, bike, home, cute, rain, boat, feet, tail**.

You're becoming a super reader! 🌟

Mathematics.summary_markdown:
# 📏 Mathematics — Measuring Length (Meters & Centimeters)

Welcome back, Grade 2! This term we measure things all around us. 📐

## 📐 Two Units of Length
- **Centimeter (cm)** — for **short** things, like a pencil or a crayon
- **Meter (m)** — for **long** things or distances, like a door or the classroom

**Example 1:** A pencil is about **15 cm** long.

**Example 2:** A classroom door is about **2 m** tall.

## 🛠️ Tools for Measuring
- **Ruler** — measures small things in **cm**
- **Tape measure** — measures longer things and distances in **m**

## 🤔 Which Unit to Use?
Ask: *Is it small enough to hold, or long like a hallway?*

- A crayon → **cm**
- The length of the school hallway → **m**
- A notebook → **cm**
- The distance from your house to school → **m**

## 🔍 Estimating Length
**Estimating** means making a smart guess **before** measuring.

**Example:** Look at your table. Guess: *"I think it is about 1 meter long."* Then measure to check!

## ⚖️ Comparing Lengths
**Example:** A spoon (15 cm) is **shorter** than a ruler (30 cm).

Great measuring, Grade 2! 🌟

# 🇵🇭 Filipino — Diptonggo at Klaster ng Katinig

Maligayang pagbabalik, Grade 2! Matuto tayo ng mga bagong tunog ngayong termino. 🎉

## 🔤 Ano ang Diptonggo?
Ang **diptonggo** ay dalawang patinig na magkasama sa isang pantig, tulad ng **ay, aw, iw, oy, uy**.

- **kalabaw** — may diptonggong **aw**
- **baboy** — may diptonggong **oy**
- **kahoy** — may diptonggong **oy**
- **paligo** → **maligo** — hindi diptonggo (magkahiwalay ang pantig)

**Halimbawa 1:** *"Ang kalabaw ay tumakbo sa parang."*

**Halimbawa 2:** *"Bumili kami ng kahoy sa gubat."*

## 🧩 Ano ang Klaster ng Katinig?
Ang **klaster** ay dalawang katinig na magkasama bago ang patinig, tulad ng **pl, pr, tr, bl**.

- **plato** — may klaster na **pl**
- **trak** — may klaster na **tr**
- **bloke** — may klaster na **bl**

**Halimbawa:** *"Naglagay ako ng pagkain sa plato."*

## 🗣️ Pagsasanay sa Pagbigkas
Subukang bigkasin nang malinaw: **kalabaw, baboy, kahoy, plato, trak, bloke**.

Magaling ka talaga, Grade 2! 🌟

# 🌱 Science — Parts of a Plant

Welcome to Term 2, Grade 2! Let's explore the plants around us. 🌿

## 🌳 Common Plants in the Community
We see many kinds of plants — **trees**, **shrubs**, **vegetables**, and **flowers**.

**Example 1:** A **mango tree** is a tree that gives us fruit.
**Example 2:** **Kangkong** is a vegetable plant we can eat.

## 🌼 The Basic Parts of a Plant
| Part | Job |
|---|---|
| **Root** | holds the plant in soil and takes in water |
| **Stem** | carries water and food, holds the plant up |
| **Leaf** | makes food using sunlight |
| **Flower** | makes seeds |
| **Fruit** | protects the seeds inside |
| **Seed** | grows into a new plant |

**Example:** The **roots** of a santan plant drink water from the soil, and the **leaves** use sunlight to make food.

## 🔍 Look Closely!
Next time you see a plant, try to point to its **root, stem, leaf,** and **flower**.

## 💚 Why Plants Matter
Plants give us **food**, **shade**, and **clean air** to breathe.

You're a plant expert now! 🌟

# 🎎 Makabansa — Ano ang Kultura?

Maligayang pagbabalik, Grade 2! Alamin natin ang tungkol sa **kultura**. 🌏

## 🎭 Kahulugan ng Kultura
Ang **kultura** ay ang paraan ng **pamumuhay, paniniwala, at kaugalian** ng isang grupo ng tao. Ito ay ipinapasa mula sa **matatanda** tungo sa mga **bata**.

**Halimbawa 1:** Ang paraan ng pagluluto ng ating Lola ay bahagi ng ating kultura.

**Halimbawa 2:** Ang mga kuwentong ikinukuwento ng ating mga magulang ay bahagi rin ng kultura.

## 🗺️ Iba't Ibang Kultura sa Pilipinas
Magkaiba-iba ang kultura ng bawat komunidad sa Pilipinas — depende sa **wika, pagkain, damit,** at **kaugalian**.

- Sa ibang lugar, **suman** ang minamasarap na kakanin.
- Sa ibang lugar, **malong** ang karaniwang kasuotan.

## 🤝 Bakit Mahalaga ang Kultura?
- Nagbibigay ito ng **pagkakakilanlan** (identity) sa isang grupo ng tao.
- Nagpapakita ito kung sino tayo bilang mga **Pilipino**.

**Halimbawa:** Kapag sinasayaw natin ang **tinikling**, ipinapakita natin ang ating kultura.

Magaling, Grade 2! 🌟

# ⌨️ Computer — Meet the Keyboard!

Welcome to Term 2, Grade 2! Today we explore the **keyboard**. 💻

## 🔤 Parts of the Keyboard
- **Letter keys** — the keys with letters **A to Z**
- **Number keys** — the keys with numbers **0 to 9**, usually on top
- **Spacebar** — the long key at the **bottom middle**; press it to make a space between words
- **Enter/Return key** — press it to start a **new line** or confirm something

**Example 1:** To type "I am", press **I**, then the **spacebar**, then **a** and **m**.

**Example 2:** After typing a sentence, press **Enter** to move to a new line.

## ✋ Using Both Hands
We can rest our **left hand** on the left side of the keyboard and our **right hand** on the right side. This is not fast typing yet — we are just getting **comfortable**.

## 🎯 Practice Tips
- Look at the keys carefully before pressing
- Type slowly and **carefully**, not fast
- Take your time to find each key

**Example:** Try typing your own **name**, one letter at a time, checking each key.

## ⭐ Why Keyboard Skills Matter
Learning the keyboard helps us **write stories**, **type our names**, and use computers for **learning**.

Great job exploring the keyboard! 🌟

GMRC.summary_markdown:
# 💛 GMRC — Tamang Pakikitungo sa Iba

Maligayang pagbabalik, Grade 2! Ngayong termino, pag-usapan natin ang **accountability** o **pananagutan**. 🌟

## 🙏 Simpleng Kagandahang-Asal
- **Pagbati** — "Magandang umaga po!"
- **Pagpapaalam** — "Aalis na po ako."
- **"Salamat"** — kapag tinulungan ka
- **"Paumanhin"** — kapag nagkamali ka
- **"Pakisuyo"** — kapag humihingi ng tulong

**Halimbawa 1:** Natapakan mo ang paa ng kaklase. Sabihin: *"Paumanhin po."*

**Halimbawa 2:** Kailangan mo ng tulong sa pagbuhat ng bag. Sabihin: *"Pakisuyo pong tulungan ako."*

## 🤲 Ano ang Pananagutan (Accountability)?
Ang **pananagutan** ay ang pagtanggap sa iyong mga **salita at kilos** — tama man o mali.

- Kung nagkamali ka, **aminin** ito nang tapat.
- Kung may pangako ka, **tuparin** ito.

**Halimbawa:** Nasira mo ang laruan ng kaklase. Sabihin: *"Ako ang nakasira nito. Paumanhin, tutulungan kitang ayusin."*

## 🔄 Paglutas ng Maliliit na Alitan
Kapag may hindi pagkakaunawaan:
1. **Manahimik muna** at huminga nang malalim
2. **Aminin** kung mali ka
3. **Gumawa ng paraan** para maayos ito

Magaling na bata ka! 💫
